name: NovelAI Image SDK v0.1.3
body:
Publishes the npm packages, which v0.1.2 built but could not upload.

## Fixed

- The npm publish job called `napi artifacts`, which expects a separate `artifacts/` directory this layout does not use. The addons are now routed into their platform packages by filename suffix, so a Windows binary cannot end up in the macOS package.

Every other registry published at 0.1.2; this release differs only in the npm packages.
